cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Yes, let's reconnect. I'll come for dinner and leave at ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why you left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Of course. Put that before pudding so we finish on something nice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I'm still upset at ten?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll book another dinner. I want us to keep seeing each other without either evening running over.

mechanism: A grants relationship repair only inside a self-benefiting dinner agenda and end time, responding to continuing upset with another bounded appointment.
confusable: D74 prolongs contact until repair; D95 agrees to contact while preserving boundaries that benefit A even if repair is unfinished.
comparison: Timed dinner and pudding order differ from keeping difficult weekend content in email.
seedUse: Retain D95-a permitted why discussion before dessert and repeat dinner instead of extending the evening.
